sources.name: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList

evidence.note: ACL Anthology identifies Ribeiro, Wu, Guestrin, and Singh; ACL 2020; pages 4902-4912; Anthology ID 2020.acl-main.442; DOI 10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.442.

criteria.note: The exact peer-reviewed paper and canonical publisher record are identified.

evidence.note: The Association for Computational Linguistics primary proceedings record identifies this as an ACL 2020 Best Overall Paper.

criteria.note: ACL is authoritative for the proceedings paper and its bibliographic identity.

evidence.note: The publisher page, abstract, metadata, and PDF link were publicly accessible without authentication, fee, secret, or account.

criteria.note: Only public metadata and method review are needed.

evidence.note: ACL Anthology states materials published in or after 2016 are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation with attribution and indication of changes.

criteria.note: Runbook Sentinel will cite and paraphrase the method with attribution and will not redistribute the paper.

evidence.note: The project uses the canonical ACL publisher record directly with no third-party content intermediary.

criteria.note: No file changes custody and no derived dataset is imported.

evidence.note: The exact DOI and Anthology ID bind the cited method. Only bibliographic facts and a narrow method paraphrase are retained; no external file is acquired.

criteria.note: Canonical identifiers are sufficient for this no-download citation use.

evidence.note: The paper defines minimum functionality, invariance, and directional-expectation behavioral tests based on relationships between predictions under controlled perturbations.

criteria.note: The invariance and directional-expectation concepts fit a bounded exact relation contract; Runbook Sentinel does not import CheckList software or claim equivalent coverage.

evidence.note: The public paper contains no project secret or operational evidence, and no executable, model, dataset, macro, or active content is imported.

criteria.note: Only citation text and project-authored synthetic tests cross into repository custody.
